scope: Independent recomputation from frozen scores, frozen decisions and scored pair identities; no new model fit, prediction, evaluation overwrite or bootstrap resampling. The current script was separately reviewed for shared canonical-pair resampling and re-selection.
interpretive_limits: S/B point statistics reproduced within floating-point precision; the newly frozen bootstrap RNG differs from the original, so CI equality was not required.
Primary non-target MSE and true_effect are finite and nonnegative for all 389 query-seed records, so the primary finite-pool mask removed no query.
Effect-quartile controls retain protocol-defined invalid bootstrap counts (36 Norman; 30 Wessels); point estimates are defined.
This is a retrospective analysis; the audit does not establish independent prospective validation, causal support effects, or formal risk control.
